_doc: Achievements and daily streaks (story 10.4, services/achievements.js). An achievement counts matching events (`filter`: payload fields that must be equal, `min`: numeric payload fields at least this much, `n`: how many) separately for each kid the event names (payload.players, payload.player, else everybody) and unlocks once, with a celebration and `xpReward` xp. A streak counts days in a row on which a kid met its condition, settled when the day ends (lessons: at least `min` graded lessons that day; onTime: arrived at school in time; mission: finished a mission); missing a day starts again from zero, kindly. `milestones` pay `xp` times the days. Progress lives in shared.flags (ach.count.<id>.<player>, ach.<id>.<player>, streak.<id>.<player>, helped.<day>.<player>). Names and descriptions: i18n ach.<id>.name / .desc, streak.<id>.name / .desc.
